comment:
* A class which represents an arbitrary set of fields of some message type. This is used to
 * implement {@link DynamicMessage}, and also to represent extensions in {@link GeneratedMessage}.
 * This class is package-private, since outside users should probably be using {@link
 * DynamicMessage}.
 *
 * @author kenton@google.com Kenton Varda

methods.name: public static FieldSet<T> newFieldSet()
methods.comment: Construct a new FieldSet.

methods.name: public static FieldSet<T> emptySet()
methods.comment: Get an immutable empty FieldSet.

methods.name: public static Builder<T> newBuilder()
methods.comment: Construct a new Builder.

methods.name: boolean isEmpty()
methods.comment: Returns {@code true} if empty, {@code false} otherwise.

methods.name: public void makeImmutable()
methods.comment: Make this FieldSet immutable from this point forward.

methods.name: public boolean isImmutable()
methods.comment:
* Returns whether the FieldSet is immutable. This is true if it is the {@link #emptySet} or if
   * {@link #makeImmutable} were called.
   *
   * @return whether the FieldSet is immutable.

methods.name: public FieldSet<T> clone()
methods.comment:
* Clones the FieldSet. The returned FieldSet will be mutable even if the original FieldSet was
   * immutable.
   *
   * @return the newly cloned FieldSet

methods.name: public void clear()
methods.comment: See {@link Message.Builder#clear()}.

methods.name: public Map<T, Object> getAllFields()
methods.comment: Get a simple map containing all the fields.

methods.name: private static SmallSortedMap<T, Object> cloneAllFieldsMap(SmallSortedMap<T, Object> fields, boolean copyList)
private static void cloneFieldEntry(Map<T, Object> map, Map.Entry<T, Object> entry, boolean copyList)
public Iterator<Map.Entry<T, Object>> iterator()
methods.comment:
* Get an iterator to the field map. This iterator should not be leaked out of the protobuf
   * library as it is not protected from mutation when fields is not immutable.

methods.name: Iterator<Map.Entry<T, Object>> descendingIterator()
methods.comment:
* Get an iterator over the fields in the map in descending (i.e. reverse) order. This iterator
   * should not be leaked out of the protobuf library as it is not protected from mutation when
   * fields is not immutable.

methods.name: public boolean hasField(final T descriptor)
methods.comment: Useful for implementing {@link Message#hasField(Descriptors.FieldDescriptor)}.

methods.name: public Object getField(final T descriptor)
methods.comment:
* Useful for implementing {@link Message#getField(Descriptors.FieldDescriptor)}. This method
   * returns {@code null} if the field is not set; in this case it is up to the caller to fetch the
   * field's default value.

methods.name: public void setField(final T descriptor, Object value)
methods.comment: * Useful for implementing {@link Message.Builder#setField(Descriptors.FieldDescriptor,Object)}.

methods.name: public void clearField(final T descriptor)
methods.comment: Useful for implementing {@link Message.Builder#clearField(Descriptors.FieldDescriptor)}.

methods.name: public int getRepeatedFieldCount(final T descriptor)
methods.comment: Useful for implementing {@link Message#getRepeatedFieldCount(Descriptors.FieldDescriptor)}.

methods.name: public Object getRepeatedField(final T descriptor, final int index)
methods.comment: Useful for implementing {@link Message#getRepeatedField(Descriptors.FieldDescriptor,int)}.

methods.name: public void setRepeatedField(final T descriptor, final int index, final Object value)
methods.comment:
* Useful for implementing {@link
   * Message.Builder#setRepeatedField(Descriptors.FieldDescriptor,int,Object)}.

methods.name: public void addRepeatedField(final T descriptor, final Object value)
methods.comment:
* Useful for implementing {@link
   * Message.Builder#addRepeatedField(Descriptors.FieldDescriptor,Object)}.

methods.name: private void verifyType(final T descriptor, final Object value)
methods.comment:
* Verifies that the given object is of the correct type to be a valid value for the given field.
   * (For repeated fields, this checks if the object is the right type to be one element of the
   * field.)
   *
   * @throws IllegalArgumentException the value is not of the right type

methods.name: private static boolean isValidType(final WireFormat.FieldType type, final Object value)
public boolean isInitialized()
methods.comment:
* See {@link Message#isInitialized()}. Note: Since {@code FieldSet} itself does not have any way
   * of knowing about required fields that aren't actually present in the set, it is up to the
   * caller to check that all required fields are present.

methods.name: private static boolean isInitialized(final Map.Entry<T, Object> entry)
static int getWireFormatForFieldType(final WireFormat.FieldType type, boolean isPacked)
methods.comment:
* Given a field type, return the wire type.
   *
   * @return One of the {@code WIRETYPE_} constants defined in {@link WireFormat}.

methods.name: public void mergeFrom(final FieldSet<T> other)
methods.comment: Like {@link Message.Builder#mergeFrom(Message)}, but merges from another {@link FieldSet}.

methods.name: private void mergeFromField(final Map.Entry<T, Object> entry)
public static Object readPrimitiveField(CodedInputStream input, final WireFormat.FieldType type, boolean checkUtf8) throws IOException
methods.comment:
* Read a field of any primitive type for immutable messages from a CodedInputStream. Enums,
   * groups, and embedded messages are not handled by this method.
   *
   * @param input the stream from which to read
   * @param type declared type of the field
   * @param checkUtf8 When true, check that the input is valid UTF-8
   * @return an object representing the field's value, of the exact type which would be returned by
   *     {@link Message#getField(Descriptors.FieldDescriptor)} for this field

methods.name: public void writeTo(final CodedOutputStream output) throws IOException
methods.comment: See {@link Message#writeTo(CodedOutputStream)}.

methods.name: public void writeMessageSetTo(final CodedOutputStream output) throws IOException
methods.comment: Like {@link #writeTo} but uses MessageSet wire format.

methods.name: private void writeMessageSetTo(final Map.Entry<T, Object> entry, final CodedOutputStream output) throws IOException
static void writeElement(final CodedOutputStream output, final WireFormat.FieldType type, final int number, final Object value) throws IOException
methods.comment:
* Write a single tag-value pair to the stream.
   *
   * @param output The output stream.
   * @param type The field's type.
   * @param number The field's number.
   * @param value Object representing the field's value. Must be of the exact type which would be
   *     returned by {@link Message#getField(Descriptors.FieldDescriptor)} for this field.

methods.name: static void writeElementNoTag(final CodedOutputStream output, final WireFormat.FieldType type, final Object value) throws IOException
methods.comment:
* Write a field of arbitrary type, without its tag, to the stream.
   *
   * @param output The output stream.
   * @param type The field's type.
   * @param value Object representing the field's value. Must be of the exact type which would be
   *     returned by {@link Message#getField(Descriptors.FieldDescriptor)} for this field.

methods.name: public static void writeField(final FieldDescriptorLite<?> descriptor, final Object value, final CodedOutputStream output) throws IOException
methods.comment: Write a single field.

methods.name: public int getSerializedSize()
methods.comment:
* See {@link Message#getSerializedSize()}. It's up to the caller to cache the resulting size if
   * desired.

methods.name: public int getMessageSetSerializedSize()
methods.comment: Like {@link #getSerializedSize} but uses MessageSet wire format.

methods.name: private int getMessageSetSerializedSize(final Map.Entry<T, Object> entry)
static int computeElementSize(final WireFormat.FieldType type, final int number, final Object value)
methods.comment:
* Compute the number of bytes that would be needed to encode a single tag/value pair of arbitrary
   * type.
   *
   * @param type The field's type.
   * @param number The field's number.
   * @param value Object representing the field's value. Must be of the exact type which would be
   *     returned by {@link Message#getField(Descriptors.FieldDescriptor)} for this field.

methods.name: static int computeElementSizeNoTag(final WireFormat.FieldType type, final Object value)
methods.comment:
* Compute the number of bytes that would be needed to encode a particular value of arbitrary
   * type, excluding tag.
   *
   * @param type The field's type.
   * @param value Object representing the field's value. Must be of the exact type which would be
   *     returned by {@link Message#getField(Descriptors.FieldDescriptor)} for this field.

methods.name: public static int computeFieldSize(final FieldDescriptorLite<?> descriptor, final Object value)
methods.comment: Compute the number of bytes needed to encode a particular field.
